text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The one claiming the Spring Shield is 
Narita Brian! She brilliantly takes 1st 
place!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: You ran all the way through.
You made it all the way to the finish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Without giving it everything I 
had, this victory wouldn't have been 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Narita Brian! That was so 
cool—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe you beat Rice Shower! You 
looked absolutely wonderful out there!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hey.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-Hyees!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Pay no mind to the noise. No matter what 
they say, your strength will never waver.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. You are such a 
kind person, Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice's story doesn't end here either, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because there are people I want to make 
happy someday.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Narita Briaaan! Good luck in the next one 
too! Don't you lose!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Narita Briaaan! Briaaan!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Give it everything you've got! Rice 
Shower!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, I'll do my best.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...She's really strong.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Merely having raw strength does not earn 
you the right to stand here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I shall continue to ascend. All 
the way to the peak of this world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If we're aiming for the pinnacle starting 
from now, there's the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown, a fierce battle distinct from the 
Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Senior Class pinnacle showdown, the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn). The Japan Cup, 
contending against world-class 
competitors. And the year-end Grand Prix, 
the Arima Kinen.
choice_data_list:
Shall we aim for the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...If you're telling me that the strength 
I'm searching for is there."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we were set to advance to the 
first leg of the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown, the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
